author: harness-hub
description:
TermGrade train (Harbor tasks for HF sandboxes)
	

904 tasks of ai-and/termgrade-environments
(Apache-2.0), converted to run on one published image, docker.io/ybelkada/termgrade-base:v1: each task's setup.sh runs when its sandbox starts
(see prepare_termgrade.py).

Read by launcher_eval.py / launcher_train.py as --split <this repo>@<revision>.
Contains the hidden tests and reference solutions. Keep this repository private, and keep it out of any training
data.
